verses.text: E happen for di seventh year, for di fifth month, for di tenth day of di month, say some of di elders of Israel come to inquire of di Lord, and sit before me.
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, speak to di elders of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: Una don come to inquire of me? As I live, I no go dey inquired of by una,’ talk di Lord God.
You go judge dem, son of man, you go judge dem? Cause dem to know di abominations of dem fathers.

Tell dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: For di day wey I choose Israel, and lift up my hand to di offspring of di house of Jacob, and make myself known to dem for di land of Egypt, when I lift up my hand to dem, saying, “I be di Lord una God,”
for dat day I lift up my hand to dem, to bring dem out of di land of Egypt into land wey I don search out for dem, flowing with milk and honey, wey be di glory of all di lands.
I talk to dem, “Everyone cast away di abominations of im eyes, and no defile yourselves with di idols of Egypt. I be di Lord una God.”

But dem rebel against me, and no listen to me. Dem no everyone cast away di abominations of dem eyes, neither dem forsake di idols of Egypt. Den I say I go pour out my wrath on dem, to accomplish my anger against dem for di middle of di land of Egypt.
But I work for my name sake, so that e no go dey profaned for di sight of di nations, among whom dem dey, for whose sight I make myself known to dem, to bring dem out of di land of Egypt.
So I cause dem to go out of di land of Egypt, and bring dem into di wilderness.
I give dem my statutes, and show dem my ordinances, which if man do, e go live by dem.
Moreover I give dem my Sabbaths, to be sign between me and dem, so that dem go know say I be di Lord wey sanctify dem.

But di house of Israel rebel against me for di wilderness. Dem no waka for my statutes, and dem despise my ordinances, which if man do, e go live by dem. My Sabbaths dem greatly profane. Den I say I go pour out my wrath on dem for di wilderness, to consume dem.
But I work for my name sake, so that e no go dey profaned for di sight of di nations, for whose sight I bring dem out.
Moreover I lift up my hand to dem for di wilderness, say I no go bring dem into di land wey I don give dem, flowing with milk and honey, wey be di glory of all di lands,
because dem despise my ordinances, and no waka for my statutes, and profane my Sabbaths, because dem heart go after dem idols.
Nevertheless my eye spare dem, so that I no destroy dem, neither make full end of dem for di wilderness.
I talk to dem children for di wilderness, “No waka for di statutes of una fathers, neither keep dem ordinances, nor defile yourselves with dem idols.
I be di Lord una God. Waka for my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do dem.
Hallow my Sabbaths, and dem go be sign between me and una, so that una go know say I be di Lord una God.”

But di children rebel against me. Dem no waka for my statutes, neither keep my ordinances to do dem, which if man do, e go live by dem. Dem profane my Sabbaths. Den I say I go pour out my wrath on dem, to accomplish my anger against dem for di wilderness.
Nevertheless I withdraw my hand, and work for my name sake, so that e no go dey profaned for di sight of di nations, for whose sight I bring dem out.
Moreover I lift up my hand to dem for di wilderness, say I go scatter dem among di nations, and disperse dem through di countries,
because dem no execute my ordinances, but despise my statutes, and profane my Sabbaths, and dem eyes dey after dem fathers idols.
Moreover I give dem also statutes wey no good, and ordinances wey dem no go live by.
I pollute dem for dem own gifts, in that dem cause to pass through di fire all wey open di womb, so that I go make dem desolate, to di end that dem go know say I be di Lord.’
Therefore, son of man, speak to di house of Israel, and talk to dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: Yet for dis una fathers don blaspheme me, in that dem don commit trespass against me.

Because when I don bring dem into di land, wey I lift up my hand to give to dem, den dem see every high hill, and every thick tree, and dem offer dem sacrifices dere, and dem present di provocation of dem offering dere. Dere also dem make dem sweet savour, and pour out dem drink offerings dere.
Den I talk to dem, “Wetin di high place dey wey una go?” So dem call im name Bamah to dis day.’
Therefore talk to di house of Israel, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: Una dey polluting yourselves after di way of una fathers? Una dey play di prostitute after dem abominations?

When una offer una gifts, when una make una sons pass through di fire, una dey pollute yourselves with all una idols, even to dis day. Una go dey inquired of by me, house of Israel? As I live,’ talk di Lord God, ‘I no go dey inquired of by una.
Wetin dey una mind no go happen at all, wey una talk, “We go be like di nations, like di families of di countries, to serve wood and stone.”
As I live,’ talk di Lord God, ‘surely with mighty hand, and with outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I go be king over una.
I go bring una out from di peoples, and gather una out of di countries where una dey scattered, with mighty hand, and with outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
I go bring una into di wilderness of di peoples, and dere I go plead with una face to face.
Like how I plead with una fathers for di wilderness of di land of Egypt, so I go plead with una,’ talk di Lord God.
‘I go cause una to pass under di rod, and I go bring una into di bond of di covenant.
I go purge out from among una di rebels, and dem wey transgress against me. I go bring dem out of di land where dem sojourn, but dem no go enter into di land of Israel. Una go know say I be di Lord.’

As for una, house of Israel,” talk di Lord God, “go, serve everyone im idols, and hereafter also, if una no go listen to me. But una no go profane my holy name any more with una gifts, and with una idols.

Because for my holy mountain, for di mountain of di height of Israel,” talk di Lord God, “dere all di house of Israel, all of dem, for di land, go serve me. Dere I go accept dem, and dere I go require una offerings and di first fruits of una offerings, with all una holy things.
I go accept una as sweet savour, when I bring una out from di peoples, and gather una out of di countries where una don dey scattered. I go dey sanctified among una for di sight of di nations.
Una go know say I be di Lord, when I bring una into di land of Israel, into di country wey I lift up my hand to give to una fathers.
Dere una go remember una ways, and all una doings, wherein una don dey polluted. Una go loathe yourselves for una own sight for all una evils wey una don commit.
Una go know say I be di Lord, when I don deal with una for my name sake, no according to una evil ways, nor according to una corrupt doings, house of Israel,” talk di Lord God.
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, set your face toward di south, and speak toward di south, and prophesy against di forest of di field for di South.

Talk to di forest of di South, ‘Hear di word of di Lord: Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go kindle fire for you, and e go devour every green tree for you, and every dry tree. Di flaming flame no go dey quenched, and all faces from di south to di north go dey burned by am.
All flesh go see say I, di Lord, don kindle am. E no go dey quenched.’”
Den I talk, “Ah Lord God! Dem dey talk of me, ‘Dis one no dey speak parables?’”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and speak toward di holy places, and prophesy against di land of Israel.
Talk to di land of Israel, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: See, I dey against you, and I go draw my sword out of im sheath, and go cut off from you di righteous and di wicked.
Seeing say I go cut off from you di righteous and di wicked, therefore my sword go go out of im sheath against all flesh from di south to di north.
All flesh go know say I, di Lord, don draw my sword out of im sheath. E no go return again.’
Sigh therefore, you son of man. Sigh with breaking heart and bitterness before dem eyes.

E go be, when dem talk to you, ‘Why you sigh?’ say you go talk, ‘Because of di news, because e dey come. Every heart go melt, and all hands go be feeble, and every spirit go faint, and all knees go be weak as water. See, e dey come, and e go dey accomplished,’ talk di Lord God.”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, prophesy, and talk, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: Talk, “Sword, sword, e dey sharpened, and also polished.
E dey sharpened to make slaughter. E dey polished so that e go flash like lightning. Or we go make mirth? E don despise di rod of my son, as e do every tree.
E dey given to be polished, so that e go dey handled. Di sword dey sharpened, yes, e dey polished, to give am into di hand of di killer.
Cry and howl, son of man, because e dey on my people. E dey on all di princes of Israel. Dem dey delivered over to di sword with my people. Strike therefore your thigh.
Because na trial. Wetin if even di rod wey despise no go be again?” talk di Lord God.’

You, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Make di sword dey doubled di third time, di sword of di slain. E na di sword of di great one wey dey slain, wey enter into dem private rooms.
I don set di threatening sword against all dem gates, so that dem heart go melt, and dem stumbling go multiply. Ah! E dey made bright. E dey wrapped up for slaughter.
Go one way or another, set yourself in array, turn to di right, set your face to di left, wherever your face dey set.
I go also strike my hands together, and I go cause my wrath to rest. I, di Lord, don speak am.”
Di word of di Lord come to me again, say,
“Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, so that di sword of di king of Babylon go come. Dem both go come out of one land. Make mark, make am for di head of di way to di city.
Appoint way for di sword to come to Rabbah of di children of Ammon, and to Judah for Jerusalem di fortified.
Because di king of Babylon stand at di parting of di way, at di head of di two ways, to use divination. E shake di arrows. E consult di teraphim. E look for di liver.

For im right hand dey di lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open di mouth for slaughter, to lift up di voice with shouting, to set battering rams against di gates, to cast up mounds, to build siege walls.
E go be to dem like false divination for dem sight, who don sworn oaths to dem, but e go bring iniquity to remembrance, so that dem go dey taken.

Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: Because una don cause your iniquity to dey remembered, in that una transgressions dey uncovered, so that in all una doings una sins appear, because una don come to remembrance, una go dey taken with di hand.
You, deadly wounded wicked one, di prince of Israel, whose day don come, for di time of di iniquity of di end,
di Lord God talk like dis: Remove di turban, and take off di crown. Dis go no dey as e dey. Exalt dat wey dey low, and abase dat wey dey high.
I go overturn, overturn, overturn am. Dis go no dey again, until e come whose right e be, and I go give am to am.”

“You, son of man, prophesy and talk, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis concerning di children of Ammon, and concerning dem reproach: Talk, “Sword, sword dey drawn. For di slaughter e dey polished, to consume, so that e go flash like lightning,
while dem see for you false visions, while dem divine lies to you, to lay you on di necks of di slain wicked, whose day don come, for di time of di iniquity of di end.
Return am into im sheath. For di place where you dey created, for di land of your birth, I go judge you.
I go pour out my indignation on you. I go blow against you with di fire of my wrath, and I go deliver you into di hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.
You go be fuel to di fire. Your blood go dey for di middle of di land. You no go dey remembered, because I, di Lord, don speak am.”’”
Moreover di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“You, son of man, you go judge, you go judge di bloody city? Den cause am to know all her abominations.
You go talk, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: City wey shed blood for di middle of am, so that her time go come, and wey make idols against herself to defile her!

You don become guilty for your blood wey you don shed, and don defile yourself with your idols wey you don make. You don cause your days to draw near, and don come to your years. Therefore I don make you reproach to di nations, and mocking to all di countries.
Dem wey dey near, and dem wey dey far from you, go mock you, you wey dey infamous, and full of tumult.
See, di princes of Israel, everyone according to im power, don dey in you to shed blood.
For you dem don treat father and mother with contempt. For di middle of you dem don deal with di foreigner by oppression. For you dem don wrong di fatherless and di widow.
You don despise my holy things, and don profane my Sabbaths.
Slanderous men dey in you to shed blood. For you dem don eat on di mountains. For di middle of you dem commit lewdness.
For you dem don uncover dem fathers nakedness. For you dem don humble her wey dey unclean for her period.
One commit abomination with im neighbour wife. Another lewdly defile im daughter-in-law. Another for you humble im sister, im father daughter.
For you dem don take bribes to shed blood. You don take interest and increase, and you don greedily gain from your neighbours by oppression, and don forget me,’ talk di Lord God.
‘See, therefore I don strike my hand at your dishonest gain wey you don make, and at di blood wey don dey inside you.
Your heart go endure, or your hands go be strong, for di days wey I go deal with you? I, di Lord, don speak am, and I go do am.
I go scatter you among di nations, and disperse you through di countries, and I go consume your filthiness out of you.
You go dey profaned in yourself for di sight of di nations, and you go know say I be di Lord.’”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, di house of Israel don become dross to me. All of dem na bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead, for di middle of di furnace. Dem na di dross of silver.
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Because una don all become dross, see, therefore I go gather una into di middle of Jerusalem.

As dem gather silver, and bronze, and iron, and lead, and tin into di middle of di furnace, to blow fire on am, to melt am, so I go gather una in my anger and in my wrath, and I go lay una dere, and melt una.
Yes, I go gather una, and blow on una with di fire of my wrath, and una go dey melted inside am.
As silver dey melted for di middle of di furnace, so una go dey melted for di middle of am. Una go know say I, di Lord, don pour out my wrath on una.’”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, talk to her, ‘Una na land wey dem no cleanse, wey no get rain for di day of indignation.’

Conspiracy dey of her prophets for di middle of her, like roaring lion wey dey tear di prey. Dem don devour souls. Dem take treasure and precious things. Dem don make many widows for di middle of her.

Her priests don do violence to my law, and don profane my holy things. Dem no make difference between di holy and di common, neither dem cause men to discern between di unclean and di clean, and dem hide dem eyes from my Sabbaths, and I dey profaned among dem.
Her princes for di middle of her dey like wolves wey dey tear di prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, so that dem go get dishonest gain.
Her prophets don plaster for dem with whitewash, seeing vanity, and divining lies to dem, saying, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis,’ when di Lord no speak.
Di people of di land don use oppression, and exercise robbery, and don wrong di poor and needy. Yes, dem don oppress di foreigner wrongfully.
I seek for man among dem wey go build up di wall, and stand for di gap before me for di land, so that I no go destroy am, but I no find any.
Therefore I don pour out my indignation on dem. I don consume dem with di fire of my wrath. Dem way I don bring on dem own heads,” talk di Lord God.
Di word of di Lord come to me again, say,
“Son of man, two women dey, di daughters of one mother.
Dem play di prostitute for Egypt. Dem play di prostitute for dem youth. For dere dem breasts dey pressed, and for dere dem virgin nipples dey handled.
Dem names na Oholah di elder, and Oholibah her sister. Dem dey mine, and dem bear sons and daughters. As for dem names, Samaria na Oholah, and Jerusalem na Oholibah.
Oholah play di prostitute when she still dey mine. She dote on her lovers, on di Assyrians her neighbours,
wey dey clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of dem desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
She give her prostitution to dem, all of dem di choice men of Assyria, and on whomever she dote. With all dem idols she defile herself.
She no leave her prostitution wey she bring from Egypt, because for her youth dem lie with her, and dem press her virgin breasts, and pour out dem prostitution on her.
Therefore I deliver her into di hand of her lovers, into di hand of di Assyrians, on whom she dote.
Dem uncover her nakedness. Dem take her sons and her daughters, and kill her with di sword. She become byword among women, because dem execute judgments on her.
Her sister Oholibah see dis, yet she dey more corrupt pass her for her lusting, and for her prostitution, wey pass her sister prostitution.
She dote on di Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbours, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of dem desirable young men.
I see say she dey defiled. Dem both take one way.
She increase her prostitution, because she see men portrayed on di wall, images of di Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,
girded with belts on dem waists, with flowing turbans on dem heads, all of dem look like princes, after di likeness of di Babylonians, wey be dem native land.
As soon as she see dem, she dote on dem, and send messengers to dem for Chaldea.
Di Babylonians come to her to di bed of love, and dem defile her with dem prostitution. She dey defiled with dem, and her soul dey alienated from dem.
So she uncover her prostitution, and uncover her nakedness. Den my soul dey alienated from her, like how my soul dey alienated from her sister.
Yet she multiply her prostitution, remembering di days of her youth, wherein she play di prostitute for di land of Egypt.
She dote on dem paramours, whose flesh dey like di flesh of donkeys, and whose issue dey like di issue of horses.
Na so you call to remembrance di lewdness of your youth, when di Egyptians press your nipples because of di breasts of your youth.
Therefore, Oholibah, di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul dey alienated, and I go bring dem against you on every side:

di Babylonians, and all di Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all di Assyrians with dem, desirable young men, all of dem governors and rulers, officers and men of renown, all of dem riding on horses.

Dem go come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with assembly of peoples. Dem go set against you shield and buckler and helmet round about. I go commit di judgment to dem, and dem go judge you according to dem judgments.

I go set my jealousy against you, and dem go deal with you in fury. Dem go take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant go fall by di sword. Dem go take your sons and your daughters, and your residue go dey devoured by di fire.
Dem go also strip you of your clothes, and take away your beautiful jewels.
So I go make your lewdness cease from you, and your prostitution wey you bring from di land of Egypt, so that you no go lift up your eyes to dem, nor remember Egypt any more.
Because di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go deliver you into di hand of dem wey you hate, into di hand of dem from whom your soul dey alienated.
Dem go deal with you in hatred, and go take away all your labour, and go leave you naked and bare. Di nakedness of your prostitution go dey uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
Dem go do dis things to you, because you don play di prostitute after di nations, and because you don dey defiled with dem idols.
You don waka for di way of your sister. Therefore I go give her cup into your hand.
Di Lord God talk like dis: You go drink your sister cup, wey deep and large. You go dey laughed to scorn and held in derision, for e contain much.
You go dey filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with di cup of astonishment and desolation, with di cup of your sister Samaria.
You go drink am and drain am out, and you go gnaw di broken pieces of am, and tear your breasts, because I don speak am,” talk di Lord God.
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: “Because you don forget me, and cast me behind your back, therefore bear di consequences of your lewdness and of your prostitution.”
Di Lord talk moreover to me: “Son of man, you go judge Oholah and Oholibah? Den declare to dem dem abominations.
Because dem don commit adultery, and blood dey on dem hands. Dem don commit adultery with dem idols. Dem don also cause dem sons, wey dem bear to me, to pass through di fire to dem to dey devoured.
Moreover dis dem don do to me: dem don defile my sanctuary for di same day, and don profane my Sabbaths.
Because when dem don kill dem children to dem idols, den dem come di same day into my sanctuary to profane am. See, na so dem do inside my house.
Moreover dem even send for men wey come from far, to whom dem send messenger, and see, dem come. For dem you wash yourself, paint your eyes, and decorate yourself with ornaments,
and sit upon stately bed, with table prepared before am, whereon you set my incense and my oil.
Di voice of multitude wey dey at ease dey with her. With men of di common sort dem bring drunkards from di wilderness. Dem put bracelets on di hands of di women, and beautiful crowns on dem heads.
Den I talk concerning her wey dey worn out by adulteries, ‘Now dem go play di prostitute with her, even she.’
Dem go in to her, as dem go in to prostitute. So dem go in to Oholah and to Oholibah, di lewd women.
Righteous men go judge dem with di judgment of adulteresses, and with di judgment of women wey shed blood, because dem na adulteresses, and blood dey on dem hands.”
Because di Lord God talk like dis: “I go bring up assembly against dem, and go give dem to be tossed to and fro and plundered.
Di assembly go stone dem with stones, and dispatch dem with dem swords. Dem go kill dem sons and dem daughters, and burn up dem houses with fire.
So I go cause lewdness to cease out of di land, so that all women go dey taught not to do according to your lewdness.
Dem go repay your lewdness on you, and una go bear di sins of your idols. Una go know say I be di Lord God.”
Again for di ninth year, for di tenth month, for di tenth day of di month, di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, write di name of di day, even of dis same day. Di king of Babylon don lay siege to Jerusalem dis same day.
Utter parable to di rebellious house, and talk to dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: Set on di pot, set am on, and also pour water into am.
Gather di pieces of am into am, even every good piece, di thigh and di shoulder. Fill am with di choice bones.
Take di choice of di flock, and pile di bones under am. Make am boil well. Yes, make di bones of am boil inside am.’
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Woe to di bloody city, to di pot wey im rust dey inside am, and wey im rust no don go out of am! Bring am out piece by piece. No cast lots for am.
Because her blood dey for her middle. She set am on di bare rock. She no pour am on di ground, to cover am with dust.
So that e go cause fury to come up, to take vengeance, I don set her blood on di bare rock, so that e no go dey covered.’
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Woe to di bloody city! I also go make di pile great.
Heap on di wood. Kindle di fire. Boil well di meat, and make di broth thick, and make di bones dey burned.
Den set am empty upon im coals, so that e go dey hot, and im bronze go burn, and im filthiness go dey melted inside am, and im rust go dey consumed.
E don weary me with toil, yet im great rust no go out of am. Im rust go dey for di fire.
For your filthiness dey lewdness. Because I don cleanse you, yet you no dey clean, you no go dey cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I don cause my wrath toward you to rest.

I, di Lord, don speak am. E go come to pass, and I go do am. I no go go back, neither I go spare, neither I go repent. According to your ways, and according to your doings, dem go judge you,’ talk di Lord God.”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, see, I go take away from you di desire of your eyes with stroke, yet you no go mourn nor weep, neither go your tears run down.
Sigh, but no loud. Make no mourning for di dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your shoes on your feet. No cover your lips, and no eat di bread of men.”
So I speak to di people for di morning, and for evening my wife die. I do for morning as I dey commanded.
Di people talk to me, “You no go tell us wetin dis things mean to us, say you do so?”
Den I talk to dem, “Di word of di Lord come to me, say,

‘Speak to di house of Israel, “Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go profane my sanctuary, di pride of your power, di desire of your eyes, and di pity of your soul. Your sons and your daughters wey una leave behind go fall by di sword.
Una go do as I don do. Una no go cover una lips, nor eat di bread of men.
Una headdresses go dey on una heads, and una shoes on una feet. Una no go mourn nor weep, but una go pine away for una iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
Thus Ezekiel go be sign to una. According to all wey e don do, una go do. When dis come, una go know say I be di Lord God.”’
You, son of man, for di day wey I take from dem dem stronghold, di joy of dem glory, di desire of dem eyes, and dat whereon dem set dem minds, dem sons and dem daughters,
for dat day, im wey escape go come to you, to cause you to hear am with your ears?
For dat day your mouth go dey opened to am wey escape, and you go speak, and no be mute any more. So you go be sign to dem, and dem go know say I be di Lord.”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, set your face toward di children of Ammon, and prophesy against dem.

Say to di children of Ammon, ‘Hear di word of di Lord God: Di Lord God talk like dis: Because you talk, “Aha!” against my sanctuary, when e dey profaned, and against di land of Israel, when e dey desolate, and against di house of Judah, when dem go into captivity,

therefore see, I go deliver you to di children of di east for possession, and dem go set dem encampments inside you, and make dem dwellings inside you. Dem go eat your fruit, and dem go drink your milk.
I go make Rabbah pasture for camels, and di children of Ammon resting place for flocks. Una go know say I be di Lord.’
Because di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Because you don clap your hands, and stamp with di feet, and rejoice with all di despite of your soul against di land of Israel,

therefore see, I don stretch out my hand on you, and I go deliver you for plunder to di nations. I go cut you off from di peoples, and I go cause you to perish out of di countries. I go destroy you. Den you go know say I be di Lord.’
Di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Because Moab and Seir talk, “See, di house of Judah dey like all di nations,”
therefore see, I go open di shoulder of Moab from di cities, from im cities wey dey im frontier, di glory of di country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
to di children of di east, to go against di children of Ammon, and I go give am for possession, so that di children of Ammon no go dey remembered among di nations.
I go execute judgments on Moab. Dem go know say I be di Lord.’
Di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Because Edom don deal against di house of Judah by taking vengeance, and don greatly offend, and avenge imself on dem,’
therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘I go stretch out my hand on Edom, and cut off man and animal from am. I go make am desolate from Teman. Even to Dedan dem go fall by di sword.
I go lay my vengeance on Edom by di hand of my people Israel. Dem go do for Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Dem go know my vengeance,’ talk di Lord God.
Di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Because di Philistines don deal by taking vengeance, and don take vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity,’
therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘See, I go stretch out my hand on di Philistines, and I go cut off di Cherethites, and destroy di remnant of di sea coast.
I go execute great vengeance on dem with wrathful rebukes. Dem go know say I be di Lord, when I lay my vengeance on dem.’”
E happen for di eleventh year, for di first day of di month, say di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, because Tyre don talk against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! Di gate of di peoples don break. E don turn to me. I go dey replenished, now say she dey laid waste,’
therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘See, I dey against you, Tyre, and I go cause many nations to come up against you, as di sea cause im waves to come up.
Dem go destroy di walls of Tyre, and break down im towers. I go also scrape her dust from her, and make her like bare rock.
E go be place for di spreading of nets for di middle of di sea, because I don speak am,’ talk di Lord God, ‘and e go become plunder to di nations.
Her daughters wey dey di field go dey killed by di sword. Dem go know say I be di Lord.’

Because di Lord God talk like dis: ‘See, I go bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from di north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and company, and much people.
E go kill your daughters for di field with di sword. E go make siege wall against you, and cast up mound against you, and lift up buckler against you.
E go set battering rams against your walls, and with im axes e go break down your towers.

By reason of di abundance of im horses, dem dust go cover you. Your walls go shake at di noise of di horsemen, and of di wagons, and of di chariots, when e go enter into your gates, as men enter into city wey dem don breach.
With di hoofs of im horses e go tread down all your streets. E go kill your people with di sword, and di pillars of your strength go go down to di ground.

Dem go make plunder of your riches, and make prey of your merchandise. Dem go break down your walls, and destroy your pleasant houses. Dem go lay your stones and your timber and your dust for di middle of di water.
I go cause di noise of your songs to cease, and di sound of your harps no go dey heard any more.
I go make you like bare rock. You go be place for di spreading of nets. You no go dey built again, because I, di Lord, don speak am,’ talk di Lord God.
Di Lord God talk like dis to Tyre: ‘Di islands no go shake at di sound of your fall, when di wounded cry, when slaughter dey made for di middle of you?

Den all di princes of di sea go come down from dem thrones, and lay away dem robes, and strip off dem embroidered garments. Dem go clothe demselves with trembling. Dem go sit on di ground, and go tremble every moment, and dey astonished at you.

Dem go take up lamentation over you, and talk to you, “How you don perish, wey dey inhabited by seafaring men, di renowned city, wey dey strong for di sea, she and her inhabitants, wey cause dem terror to dey on all dem wey dwell dere!
Now di islands go tremble for di day of your fall. Yes, di islands wey dey di sea go dey dismayed at your departure.”’
Because di Lord God talk like dis: ‘When I go make you desolate city, like di cities wey no dey inhabited, when I bring up di deep on you, and di great waters cover you,

den I go bring you down with dem wey descend into di pit, to di people of old time, and I go make you dwell for di lower parts of di earth, like di places wey dey desolate of old, with dem wey go down to di pit, so that you no go dey inhabited. I go set glory for di land of di living.
I go make you terror, and you no go dey again. Though dem seek you, yet dem no go find you again,’ talk di Lord God.”
